The most likely rate is Rate 2 (0.7). To find the expected probability $P(Y)$, we weight the rates by their likelihoods:
Sum of likelihoods = $0.0729 + 0.3087 + 0.1323 + 0.0081 = 0.522$
$P(Y) = \frac{(0.9 \times 0.0729) + (0.7 \times 0.3087) + (0.3 \times 0.1323) + (0.1 \times 0.0081)}{0.522}$
$P(Y) = \frac{0.06561 + 0.21609 + 0.03969 + 0.00081}{0.522} = \frac{0.3222}{0.522} \approx 0.617$
